_comment: One entry per published board. scripts/build_site.py builds each env and writes its merged image + ESP Web Tools manifest; web/index.html renders this list. status: tested = confirmed on real hardware, untested = builds, not yet run on the board. otaLayout: the env's partition table has OTA slots, so the image also writes boot_app0 to select slot 0.

boards.name: 2.8" Cheap Yellow Display
boards.hint: Yellow PCB, silkscreen ESP32-2432S028R. Upstream's original board.

boards.name: 2.8" Cheap Yellow Display (TPM408 panel)
boards.hint: Same board with "TPM408-2.8" printed on the panel flex. Pick this if the cyd build shows a mirrored or sideways image with a noisy strip.

boards.name: 3.5" Sunton capacitive
boards.hint: Same board as the resistive 3.5" with a GT911 capacitive panel.

boards.name: 3.5" Elecrow CrowPanel Advance
boards.hint: Flash through the USB port labelled USB1 (native USB).

boards.name: 4.3" Sunton
boards.hint: Silkscreen ESP32-4827S043C (the C variant, GT911 touch).

boards.name: 5" Sunton
boards.hint: Silkscreen ESP32-8048S050C-I. Also sold as JC8048W550C.

boards.name: 5" Elecrow CrowPanel
boards.hint: The red, non-Advance board, PCB V3.0.

boards.name: 5" Elecrow CrowPanel Advance
boards.hint: PCB V1.2 or V1.3. For V1.1 use the next entry.

boards.name: 5" Elecrow CrowPanel Advance v1.1
boards.hint: Only for PCB V1.1 — its backlight chip speaks a different protocol.

boards.name: 7" Sunton
boards.hint: Silkscreen ESP32-8048S070 with no trailing C.

boards.name: 7" Elecrow CrowPanel
boards.hint: PCB V3.0, silkscreen ends in C.

boards.name: 4.3" Waveshare ESP32-P4
boards.hint: Connect the UART USB-C port (CH343) to install. Bluetooth runs on the onboard ESP32-C6, which needs ESP-Hosted 2.x firmware.
